dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jul 24 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qun0](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qun0) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 115.496 depth occurred on Jul 24 2025 16km SE of Timbunke. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -4.2783 longitude 143.6306. It impacted 43157 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
